assumptions.description: Wall prisms are summed independently. T/cross/corner junction overlaps are not unioned; this is not physical masonry union volume.
One longitudinal wall face; no reveals, end/top faces or finish assembly assignment. Classification does not assign a face to interior/exterior finishes.
Space polygons use wall centerlines, not net usable finished boundaries. Floor finish basis is an alternative use of the same area; do not add these bases.
Explicit plate outer area minus disjoint modeled voids. Floor, flat roof and ceiling plates are separate categories; no implicit ceiling assembly is invented.
Sum of floor-plate net areas only. No statutory FAR/FSI interpretation.
Columns/stairs are architectural geometry, not structural design. Intersections between different entity types are not boolean-unioned.
Null specificationId means unknown; no material or assembly is inferred.
Irrational segment lengths round per segment to nearest mm, ties upward, before dependent face/volume quantities. Exact polygon areas are not rounded.
SI display values round half upward at the configured precision. Base-unit decimal strings control aggregation.

diagnostics.message: Engineering properties and unspecified materials are not evaluated.

limitations: Architectural subset only; no structural, MEP or certification data.
Wall quantities use segment prisms; junctions are not boolean-unioned.
Doors/windows are opening envelopes; no leaf, frame or glazing assembly is specified.
Stair and landing surfaces have no specified underside thickness.
Space boundaries use the native basis; no certified clear height or usable-area claim.
Site survey/georeferencing and construction recipes are not exported.
